title: Companion native chat rendering
description: Start native-stream-stack.mts with NATIVE_STREAM_RUNNER=opencode, NATIVE_STREAM_FIXTURE=native-render-opencode.cjs, NATIVE_STREAM_MODEL=synthetic/render and NATIVE_STREAM_SEED_DIR=apps/companion/scripts/agentic/native-render-seed (isolated gateway; a synthetic OpenCode ACP peer edits two files and replies with markdown). Pair the app once with `native-render-proof.mjs pair`, then set NATIVE_RENDER_CONTROL, NATIVE_RENDER_STATE (a new file), METRO_PORT and IOS_SIMULATOR. Proves through the real composer, file chips and diff controls that the reply renders as native markdown with a highlighted TypeScript fence, that a file chip opens the native source viewer highlighted and scrolled to its line, that a markdown file opens rendered and toggles to raw source, and that the tool and turn diffs render in the native diff view with highlighted rows.

proofTargets.claim: The assistant reply renders as native markdown: a list, a complete TypeScript fence and two file links.
A file chip opens the native source viewer at its line, highlighted by the native lexer, with that line on screen.
A markdown file opens rendered, and Raw shows its highlighted source.
The tool diff and the turn diff render in the native diff view with highlighted rows.

setup.intent: Create a native session with the synthetic OpenCode peer in a seeded folder.

open.intent: Open the session by deep link and wait for its history.

type.value: Bump the greeting count and write the plan.
type.intent: Ask the agent for the edit through the composer.

send.intent: Send the prompt through the shared session API.

reply.intent: The reply's markdown rendered natively with its fence and file links.

assert-reply.intent: The reply phase passed its checks.

open-fold.intent: Open the finished turn's folded work, which holds the reply.

reveal-reply.cmd: node scripts/agentic/native-render-proof.mjs reveal 'demo.ts · L32, demo.ts line 32'
reveal-reply.intent: Drag the conversation until the reply's file chip shows.

wait-chip.intent: The file link shows as a chip.

capture-reply.intent: Record the highlighted code block and the file chips.

file-line.intent: The viewer opened src/demo.ts natively at line 32, highlighted and on screen.

assert-file-line.intent: The file-line phase passed its checks.

capture-file.intent: Record the highlighted file scrolled to its line.

reveal-plan.intent: Bring the plan's file chip into view again.

press-plan.intent: Open the inline-code file chip for the plan.

markdown-rendered.intent: notes/plan.md opened rendered, with its fence and its link back to the source.

markdown-raw.intent: Raw shows the file in the native source view, highlighted as markdown.

assert-markdown.intent: Both markdown phases passed their checks.

reveal-turn-file.cmd: node scripts/agentic/native-render-proof.mjs reveal 'src/demo.ts · modified · +1 −1 · Diff' end
reveal-turn-file.intent: Return to the end of the conversation, where the turn's files are.

press-turn-file.intent: Open the turn's diff for src/demo.ts.

turn-diff.intent: The turn diff decoded and drew in the native view with highlighted rows.

tool-diff.intent: The tool diff decoded and drew in the native view with highlighted rows.

assert-diffs.intent: Both diff phases passed their checks.
